findings.notes: Trailing # v3.29.5 / # v2.22.11 comments on the bumped uses lines do not state the pinned version (v4.39.4). Pre-existing on base (F1-base-preexistence check); dependabot only refreshes a trailing comment that matches the old version, so they stay stale until manually corrected to # v4.39.4. Harness-bites verified: with comments refreshed the check goes green (results/harness-bites.log).

sonarcloud.yaml triggers are push+schedule only, so upload-sarif@1bd86f2 first executes post-merge; PR CI cannot catch a broken upload-sarif pin. Canary passes while that is true; if PR coverage is ever added, the canary flips and must be inverted.

acceptance.contract: Every github/codeql-action/*@<sha> step at head resolves to an official release tag of github/codeql-action, and all steps share one SHA equal to the tag the PR claims (v4.39.4).
The two touched workflow files parse as YAML and their action inputs are unchanged by the diff.
Trailing version comments on pinned uses lines state the version the SHA resolves to.

liveNote: L3 not applicable: no runtime/cluster behavior in this PR. The real integration signal is the GitHub-hosted CodeQL workflow run on the PR head (pull_request event), captured in results/ci-evidence.txt.
